name: Tight blocks
lesson: Every block of the trap scores best at 1111 but is rewarded for turning genes to 0, so a small population is drawn toward all zeros and rarely finds the optimum.
lookFor: In the Block states panel the bars fill with the hatched all-zeros part while few blocks reach all ones. With this seed Run until stop pauses at generation 86 because 70 generations have passed without a better individual (best so far 16); stepping on, the run reaches generation 100 without ever finding 20: the best so far is 17 and the average fitness of the last population is 13, below the 15 that all zeros would score. With these settings 2 runs in 100 (seeds 1 to 100) find 20. A run that does not find the optimum is the expected result here, not a mistake.
